Root cause: recon_lu_cpp is only validated at n4096 where gate=100*4096*eps=0.049 is loose; at n512 the gate (0.0061) is 8x tighter. Confirmed an EXACT FP64 orhr reconstruction passes (orth 8.3e-4, 0.14x gate). Test shapes (small batch B4/B16) PASS because fewer matrices keep worst-case orth under gate; large batch exposes the worst matrix.

(3) The FP64-accurate Gram is mandatory -- these 'cond<=2 dense' inputs have cond(A)~8.8e6 (logspace col scaling), so cond(G)~7.7e13 and a plain FP32 Gram is indefinite (chol fails); int-Ozaki FP64 Gram is a serial per-matrix int8 loop (~48ms at B640) and native FP64 bmm is ~5ms. CQR2's ONLY fast parts are the TF32 Gram + A@R^-1 solve (~0.3-0.6ms) -- dwarfed by (1)+(2)+(3). SUGGESTIONS for next briefs: do NOT pursue any CholeskyQR-family approach for n512/n1024 -- the reconstruction tax is fatal for ANY Q,R-producing method. The real headroom is in the EXISTING blocked-Householder path: shape3 (3637us) and shape4 (3725us) are the two biggest dense contributors; per env.md the n512 path's panel factorization + WMMA apply fusion is mature, so micro-opt there, OR target the panel's latency-bound serial Householder chain directly (the thing CQR2 was trying to avoid) with a better in-panel scheme that STILL emits (H,tau) directly. CholeskyQR is conclusively dead for n512 (you+W1+W3 proved the orhr_col reconstruction tax is fatal). The reconstruction-FREE way to make Householder QR tensor-core-bound: RECURSIVE blocked panel factorization (Elmroth-Gustavson xGEQRT). Unlike TSQR (W1 disproved -- incompatible reflectors), recursive geqrt emits STANDARD sequential Householder reflectors, so it KEEPS the exact (H,tau) contract with ZERO reconstruction. It recursively halves each panel: factor left half, apply its block-WY reflector to the right half via a GEMM (tensor-core TF32), factor right half -- converting the latency-bound serial per-column Householder chain into level-3 block GEMMs. Attack the dense n512 panel factorization (shape3 3637us, biggest single contributor). The prior run tuned the APPLY; nobody made the PANEL FACTORIZATION recursive. Branch off baseline 4320d93d. Validate HARD all 12 incl cond0; interleaved A/B; profile in isolation. ROOT CAUSE (analytical + empirical): the sequential Householder reflector chain over an OB block is exactly ob(=64) steps deep REGARDLESS of how it is recursed -- the recursion's leaves are data-dependent (the right half needs the left half factored AND applied first), so they run SERIALLY, not in parallel. This is the SAME wall the CQR2 brief hit (the n512 panel is fundamentally latency-bound by the serial reflector chain), but unlike CQR2 the recursion is a CLEAN reusable artifact (exact contract, no reconstruction tax). (3) Do NOT pursue further panel-blocking/recursion reorganizations for n512 -- the column count IS the serial depth.
